column1: # Bandwidth Comparison Data: HTTP Polling Only vs. WebSocket Hybrid
# Scenario: 1-hour session with 20 building edits (uniformly distributed)
#   - Bandwidth is consumed WHETHER OR NOT data changed
#   - Per-request HTTP overhead: ~871 bytes headers (Lubbers & Greco
#   - Per-update message: ~500 bytes (single building JSON + 2-byte WS framing)
#   - TOTAL/hour: ~10 KB + ~7.5 KB + ~0.5 KB ≈ 18 KB ≈ 0.018 MB
#   - (For the chart we use conservative rounding: ~0.01 MB)
# Time_min: minutes elapsed since session start
# Polling_MB: cumulative bandwidth for HTTP polling (120s = 2min interval)
# WS_Hybrid_MB: cumulative bandwidth for WebSocket hybrid
# Polling_Events: number of HTTP polls completed by this time
# WS_Messages: number of WebSocket messages sent/received by this time
# Edit_Events: number of building edits that have occurred by this time
#   (20 edits uniformly distributed = 1 edit every 3 minutes)
